subject: SignalGarden: maintainer compute credits & honoraria request
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena@signalgarden.org>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: compute credits + stipends for SignalGarden maintainer cohort

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the chat last week. SignalGarden is running a three-day community hackathon (June 18-20) focused on federated logging plugins. We're coordinating 12 core maintainers who will mentor teams and run workshops. A few asks from our side: 

- Grant compute credits to the nine individual maintainers who need sandbox access (roughly 3 VPS-equivalent instances for 3 days).
- A short trial extension (3 months) for the maintainers so they can continue testing integrations after the event.
- Modest honoraria: we budgeted $1,200 for facilitator stipends (split across maintainers).

Attached is a short grant form with attendee list and org details. Would Redwood be able to support a combo of credits + a promo extension? If helpful we can add SignalGarden as a HubSpot account and share the hackathon page.

Appreciate any guidance on amounts you typically approve for events like this.

Best,
Lena

[attachment: signalgarden_grant_form.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: compute credits + stipends for SignalGarden maintainer cohort

Forwarding Lena's request — SignalGarden is a small but active community. Proposed redwood support: 

- Promo: 45,000 compute credits (one-time promo code shared with maintainers)
- Trial extension: 3-month team trial for the nine maintainers (promo applies to their accounts)
- Honoraria: $1,200 one-time (we can issue as a promo credit or approve a small reimbursement)

Notes/questions: 
- Is 45k credits reasonable from a cost perspective? (Vivek, Marissa)
- If approved, Ben: can finance issue a promo code + optional invoice note that marks it as marketing/community spend?
- I'll handle HubSpot deal and DocuSign MPA if needed.

I attached their form. If we approve, I'd like to provide a single-use promo for maintainers and a short terms doc.

Thanks — Dylan

---- Forwarded message ----
[original from Lena attached above]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: compute credits + stipends for SignalGarden maintainer cohort

Dylan — I support this in principle. A couple of guardrails: 

- Cap the per-maintainer allocation to avoid overuse (suggestion: no more than 6k credits per person).
- Honoraria: convert the $1,200 into a $1,200 promo credit on the SignalGarden org record so it shows in reporting (finance prefers credits vs. small reimbursements).
- Require HubSpot deal and short MPA (DocuSign link) for audit trail.

Ben — please confirm we can create a promo code scoped to the 12 maintainers + a $1,200 credit on the SG org. If finance is happy, greenlight from me.

Marissa
Head of Developer Relations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: compute credits + stipends for SignalGarden maintainer cohort

All,

Finance confirms we can issue: 

- Promo code: SG-HACK-45K (one-time redeemable, 45,000 compute credits)
- Org credit: $1,200 applied to SignalGarden HubSpot org (visible as marketing/community promo)
- Per-person cap: we will set the promo to enforce a 6,000-credit soft limit per account; if a maintainer needs more they can request an escalation.

I've created a Drive folder with the promo terms and a short MPA template — linking here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_promo_terms.

Ben Carter
Finance — Partnerships Budget
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@signalgarden.org>, SignalGarden Maintainers <maintainers@signalgarden.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: compute credits + stipends for SignalGarden maintainer cohort — Approved

Hi Lena — great news: Redwood is happy to support SignalGarden's hackathon. Summary of what's approved: 

- Promo code SG-HACK-45K: 45,000 compute credits, one-time code.
- Per-maintainer soft cap: 6,000 credits/account (contact us if any maintainer needs an exception).
- Trial extension: three-month team trial for the listed maintainers (we'll add them to a SignalGarden org record).
- Honoraria: $1,200 applied as an org-level promo credit (shows in our reporting).

Next steps for you: 
1) Confirm the final list of maintainers (email addresses) and which email to use for the org HubSpot record.
2) Sign the short MPA — I'll send a DocuSign link (Ben has uploaded the template).
3) After DocuSign complete, we'll distribute the promo code and apply the org credit.

Thanks — excited to see what the community builds.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Program Manager, Developer Partnerships
Redwood Inference
